faqs.question: Are all components 100% genuine with official Indian warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every CPU, GPU, motherboard, RAM, and SSD carries authorized Indian distributor stickers (Rashi Peripherals, Acro, Supertron, Kaizen, Redington) and comes with an official GST invoice for direct brand warranty claims across India.

faqs.question: How are custom PCs shipped safely to other states?
faqs.answer: We use custom Instapak expanding foam inside the cabinet to immobilize the heavy graphics card and cooler, wrap the system in multi-layered air cushioning, box it in double-corrugated cartons, and dispatch via BlueDart Air with 100% transit loss and damage insurance.

faqs.question: Do you charge extra for custom PC assembly and OS installation?
faqs.answer: Zero assembly fees! We provide complimentary professional assembly with clean cable management, Thermal Grizzly thermal paste, updated motherboard BIOS, and pre-activated Windows 11 installation with 24-hour stress testing.

faqs.question: What payment options are supported?
faqs.answer: We support UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking across all Indian banks, Credit/Debit cards, and No-Cost EMI options.
